profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior Software & Infrastructure Automation Engineer with 15+ years of experience architecting high-availability, cloud-native systems, microservices, cybersecurity and enterprise automation frameworks. Proven track record of optimizing platform performance, automating complex pipelines (saving 1,000+ hours quarterly), and driving DevOps practices across multi-cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure). Deep expertise in API design, CI/CD, storage systems, and cross-functional team leadership.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as a subject-matter expert for NetBackup OpenStorage and cloud APIs (AWS S3, OpenStack Swift, Azure), managing cloud configurations, publishing new storage support, and guiding cross-team project direction.
Improved software quality and reliability by providing code fixes, performing GIT stash reviews, and designing test plans for NetBackup and Appliance Cloud Certification.
Enhanced team capabilities by updating training documents, managing SDK repositories, and training developers on AWS S3, and NetBackup Cloud APIs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led certification and automation efforts for OST, Cloud, Tape, VTL, and NDMP storage solutions across Windows, Linux, and UNIX, defining test cases, and developing test automation plans to ensure timely delivery.
Strengthened customer and partner relationships by troubleshooting product code issues, reducing response times, and providing internal teams with technical insight into customer roadmaps and challenges.
Enhanced knowledge sharing by creating technical documentation and training internal and external customers on product features and best practices.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Nicollet Mall, 10 S 5th St #900, Minneapolis, MN 55402
positions.description:
Delivered key client solutions and new products by integrating Google Custom Search ahead of schedule, building a Facebook application, and developing Deal Buster (patent pending), directly supporting contract wins and product expansion.
Improved system reliability and scalability by repairing long-standing CLR, WCF, and search bugs, troubleshooting critical automation issues, and upgrading server frameworks from 3.5 to 4.0.

positions.title: Chemical Mechanical Polishing Technical Product Support Engineer
positions.description:
Improved tool reliability and performance by resolving prototype and software issues, increasing Mean Time Between Interrupt by 69%, and tool throughput by 5%.
Delivered engineering solutions that prevented escalations, closed top customer concerns, and significantly enhanced customer satisfaction.
Conducted budget audits and corrected non-compliance issues, achieving a 31% reduction in labor hours.

positions.title: Field Technician
positions.description: Delivered end-to-end technical support and system solutions by installing, troubleshooting, and resolving critical software issues (e.g., Outlook/Antivirus conflict), while boosting team productivity by 180% and cutting training time by 50%, resulting in higher customer satisfaction and ROI.

positions.title: Electronic Lab Technician
positions.description: Supervised and maintained lab equipment, troubleshooting and repairing failures (e.g., oscilloscopes) to reduce costs and downtime, while providing hands-on instruction and customer support that improved satisfaction and project outcomes.
